author: Navjot Tomer (Mindstellar)
description_html:
QR Code

Adds a QR code to each listing, to scan from a screen, share or print.

Requirements

  • Shopclass 6.1.0 or later
  • PHP 8.0 or later
  • A browser with ES modules and dynamic import() (any browser since 2018)
  • The theme must call the item_detail hook

Install

  1. Open Plugins → Browse (or upload the zip from the GitHub release).
  2. Install.
  3. Activate.

Set up

  1. Open Plugins → Manage plugins, then Settings next to QR Code.
  2. Pick the Error correction level: L, M (recommended), Q or H.
  3. Save.

M survives a scuffed print or an off-angle scan. H gives about 30% damage tolerance but a denser symbol.

How it works

  • Every listing page gets a "Show QR code" button. No theme edit needed.
  • The code is drawn in the browser as SVG, only when asked, so it stays sharp in print. No files are stored on the server.
  • The button opens a dialog with the code and the listing address.
ActionWhen it shows
ShareThe browser has the Web Share API
Copy linkThe browser has the Clipboard API
PrintAlways. Prints the code and address at 60 mm

Notes / limits

  • Share and Copy link stay hidden until the browser supports them.
  • vendor/qrcode.js and vendor/qrcode-utf8.js are QR Code Generator for JavaScript by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT), included unchanged. See vendor/LICENSE. The UTF-8 file is needed so URLs with non-ASCII characters scan correctly.
  • Derived from the Osclass "QR Codes" plugin (1.0.3). See CHANGELOG.md.

Support

https://github.com/mindstellar/shopclass-plugins/issues

License

GPL-3.0-or-later. Derived from Osclass (Apache-2.0); both notices are kept in the source headers.

versions.changelog_html:
First Shopclass release, rewritten from the Osclass plugin (1.0.3, 2013).

Breaking

  • Codes are no longer PNG files under oc-content/uploads/qrcode/, and the upload_path and upload_url settings are gone with them. Any PNGs the old version left behind can be deleted; nothing reads them.
  • The theme-callable show_qrcode() is gone. The code renders through the item_detail hook instead, so no theme edit is needed.

Changed

  • The symbol is generated in the browser and drawn as SVG. It was rendered server-side to a PNG per listing by a bundled PHP encoder of 427 files — 400 of them a pre-computed mask cache — which required GD, accumulated a file per listing, keyed those filenames on a hash of the URL so every permalink change orphaned one, and needed a cleanup pass on item delete and on uninstall to chase them. A QR code is a pure function of a URL; none of that earned its keep.
  • The encoder is fetched only when a visitor asks for a code, so a listing page that nobody scans downloads none of it.
  • Printing prints the code and the address on their own, at 60 mm.

New

  • Share via the Web Share API and Copy link via the Clipboard API, each shown only where the browser supports it.
  • The code opens in a native <dialog>, so the backdrop, focus handling and Escape are the browser's job.
  • Error-correction level is a setting; it was fixed before.

Fixed

  • Non-ASCII addresses produced an unscannable code. Encoding wrote one byte per code unit, so a URL with an accented or non-Latin slug came out wrong. UTF-8 encoding is now used, verified against an independent decoder.
  • The plugin rendered nothing at all on a theme that did not call show_qrcode() itself.
  • Dropped the osc_version() < 320 branch and the getConnection()/commit() calls in install and uninstall, none of which had meant anything for years.
